# EasyCommercialInsurance.com

> Independent Florida commercial insurance agency — business owners policies,
> general liability, workers compensation and commercial auto, quoted across
> multiple carriers. Part of Tomlinson & Co, licensed since 1966.
> Quotes: 800-616-1418.

EasyCommercialInsurance.com is the commercial lines division of Tomlinson & Co,
an independent agency licensed since 1966. As an independent agency we are not
tied to a single carrier; we compare quotes across multiple admitted and
surplus-lines markets writing Florida business risk.

## What we write

- **Business Owners Policy (BOP)** — general liability and commercial property
  bundled, usually the most cost-effective option for a small or mid-sized business
- **General Liability** — premises, products and completed operations, personal
  and advertising injury
- **Workers Compensation** — Florida's requirements vary by industry and
  headcount; construction thresholds are lower than most owners expect
- **Commercial Auto** — owned, hired and non-owned vehicles
- **Commercial Umbrella** — excess limits above the underlying policies

## Service area

Florida, statewide.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Eligibility, limits and premium depend on the specific business: industry
  class, payroll, revenue, location, claims history and coverage selected.
  Figures cited in articles are general market context, not quotes.
- Nothing on this site binds coverage. A licensed agent must review the risk and
  issue a policy.
- Florida workers compensation requirements differ by industry — construction
  thresholds are lower than for most other businesses. Check the specific class
  rather than assuming a general rule.
